subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to the remaining Discord monitor boundary, with embedded-runner cleanup owned exclusively by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72072?
rationale: Current main and the active RFC clearly own only the embedded-runner half; maintainer intent is needed to preserve a focused Discord tracker rather than retain a cross-domain umbrella or leave the cleanup opportunistic.

options.title: Narrow to Discord
options.body: Keep this issue open for staged Discord preflight, processing, and provider decomposition while treating the RuntimePlan RFC as canonical for embedded-runner cleanup.

options.title: Keep umbrella scope
options.body: Retain both areas here as a high-level tracker while coordinating every embedded-runner slice with the RuntimePlan RFC.

options.title: Close as opportunistic
options.body: Close this issue and extract Discord boundaries only when future behavior changes require them.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Discord
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for staged Discord preflight, processing, and provider decomposition while treating the RuntimePlan RFC as canonical for embedded-runner cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the latest embedded-runner phase split, reviewed this issue, and have recent history in the Discord monitor files.
